Restaurant

Curry, Wok & Waves

An exquisite open-air dining space designed to delight every sense. Savour vibrant Indian cuisine and delicate Chinese fare — buffet-style or à la carte — while sweeping views of Morjim Beach and the sea breeze become part of your meal.

Seats up to 40 guests — perfect for romantic dinners, family gatherings, and team lunches.
